ei.title: Chapter 3-08 2번: The Opportunity Cost of Limited Resources
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to ①<u>provide</u> all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation ③<u>what</u> we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water ②<u>consumed</u> cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire ④<u>burns</u>. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: what → that: 선행사 recreation이 있으므로 관계대명사 that이 적절하다. what은 선행사를 포함하는 관계대명사이므로 선행사가 있을 때 사용할 수 없다.
det.analysis:
① provide — to provide all of the wood, to부정사 동사원형 정상
② consumed — the water consumed, 과거분사(수동) 후치수식 정상
③ what — 원문 that, 선행사(recreation)가 있으므로 관계대명사 that 필요. what은 선행사 포함 ←정답
④ burns — while the fire burns, 3인칭 단수 현재형 정상
det.tip: what = the thing that (선행사 포함). 선행사가 이미 있으면 that/which 사용

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not ①<u>enough</u> to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve ②<u>trails</u> and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew ③<u>themselves</u>, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our ④<u>limited</u> resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: themselves → itself: a forest는 단수이므로 재귀대명사도 itself가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
① enough — not enough to provide, 부사 정상
② trails — improve trails and campsites, 복수명사 정상
③ themselves — 원문 itself, a forest(단수) → itself(단수 재귀대명사) 필요 ←정답
④ limited — our limited resources, 과거분사(형용사) 정상
det.tip: a forest(단수) → renew itself(단수 재귀대명사). themselves는 복수 주어용

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the ①<u>accessible</u> recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and ②<u>campsites</u>, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of ③<u>fresh</u> water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to ④<u>making</u> choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: making → make: have to 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 한다. have to making은 비문.
det.analysis:
① accessible — the accessible recreation, 형용사 정상
② campsites — trails and campsites, 복수명사 정상
③ fresh — fresh water, 형용사 정상
④ making — 원문 make, have to + 동사원형(make) 필요 ←정답
det.tip: have to + 동사원형: have to make choices (O). have to making (X)

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, ④<u>or</u> improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water ①<u>consuming</u> cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution ②<u>downwind</u> while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities ③<u>lost</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: consuming → consumed: the water consumed는 '소비된 물'로 수동의 의미이다. consuming(현재분사, 능동)으로 바꾸면 '소비하는 물'이 되어 의미가 부자연스럽다.
det.analysis:
① consuming — 원문 consumed, the water consumed(수동: 소비된 물) 필요 ←정답
② downwind — air pollution downwind, 부사 정상
③ lost — opportunities lost, 과거분사(수동: 잃어버린 기회들) 정상
④ or — build roads, or improve trails, 접속사 정상
det.tip: the water consumed = 소비된 물 (수동). the water consuming = 소비하는 물 (능동, 비논리)

questions.passage: We have vast ①<u>forests</u> in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we ②<u>gain</u> some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of ③<u>fresh</u> water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make ④<u>choices</u> about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '얻다(gain)'가 아니라 '잃다(lose)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 나무를 벌목하고 도로를 건설하면 황무지의 일부를 잃는다.
det.analysis:
① forests — vast forests, 원문 일치
② gain — 원문은 lose(잃다), 벌목/건설 → 황무지 상실 ←정답
③ fresh — fresh water, 원문 일치
④ choices — make choices, 원문 일치
det.tip: lose(잃다) ↔ gain(얻다). 개발행위 → 자연 상실의 논리

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the ①<u>wood</u>, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to ②<u>grow</u> rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to ③<u>help</u> a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The ④<u>benefit</u> of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '이익(benefit)'이 아니라 '비용(cost)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 선택의 대가는 우리가 포기하는 것이다.
det.analysis:
① wood — all of the wood, 원문 일치
② grow — grow rice in California, 원문 일치
③ help — help a forest renew itself, 원문 일치
④ benefit — 원문은 cost(비용), 포기하는 것 = 기회비용 ←정답
det.tip: cost(비용) ↔ benefit(이익). 기회비용은 포기한 것의 가치

det.analysis:

det.korean: 본문: 'the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities' — 소비된 물은 식수로 사용될 수 없다.
det.analysis:
T — 식수로 재활용 가능? 본문은 cannot be used라고 명시
F — 소비된 물은 식수로 사용 불가. 본문과 반대 진술 ←정답

det.analysis:
T — 불 사용 시 바람 하류에 대기 오염 발생. 원문 일치 ←정답
F — 본문 내용과 일치하는 진술
det.tip: downwind = 바람이 부는 쪽(풍하). 불 → 대기 오염이라는 트레이드오프

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for __________. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 쌀 재배에 사용된 물은 캘리포니아 도시의 식수로 사용될 수 없다. 자원의 기회비용을 보여주는 예시.
det.analysis:
❌ ① growing more rice for export — 더 많은 쌀 수출 재배 (다른 문장 개념)
✅ ② drinking water in California cities — 캘리포니아 도시 식수 ←정답
❌ ③ air pollution downwind — 풍하 대기 오염 (다음 문장 개념)
❌ ④ improving trails and campsites — 등산로/야영지 개선 (이전 문장 개념)
det.tip: 물의 기회비용: 쌀 재배 OR 식수. 둘 다는 불가능

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 선택의 비용은 우리가 포기하는 것, 즉 잃어버린 기회의 비용이다. 기회비용 개념의 핵심 정의.
det.analysis:
❌ ① air pollution downwind — 풍하 대기오염 (자원 사용의 결과이지 비용의 정의가 아님)
❌ ② our limited resources — 제한된 자원 (선택의 원인이지 비용의 정의가 아님)
✅ ③ the cost of opportunities lost — 잃어버린 기회의 비용 ←정답
❌ ④ the accessible recreation — 접근 가능한 여가 (자원의 종류이지 비용의 정의가 아님)
det.tip: opportunity cost = 기회비용. what we give up = 포기하는 것의 가치

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. As soon as we log trees, build roads, or improve trails and campsites, we lose some wilderness. Similarly, we have large amounts of fresh water, but if we use water to grow rice in California, the water consumed cannot be used for drinking water in California cities. If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: 본문 전체 논지: 자원은 제한되어 있고, 선택에는 비용(포기)이 따른다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 충분한 숲 — 원문은 'not enough'(충분하지 않다)
✅ ② 자원 사용에 대가 — 글 전체 핵심 주제(기회비용) ←정답
❌ ③ 식수 영향 없음 — 원문은 cannot be used for drinking water
❌ ④ 대기질 개선 — 원문은 air pollution(대기 오염) 발생
det.tip: The cost of those choices is what we give up = 선택의 대가는 포기한 것

ch: 이 나라에는 원하는 모든 것을 충족할 만큼 충분한 숲이 있다.
캘리포니아에서 쌀을 재배하면 식수 공급에는 아무런 영향이 없다.
숲에 불을 놓으면 대기 질이 오히려 개선된다.

questions.passage: We have vast forests in this country but not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation that we want. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'not enough to provide all of the wood, all of the wilderness, and all of the accessible recreation' — 모든 것을 충족할 만큼 충분하지 않다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 등산로 정비 → 자연 상충 — 원문 일치 (lose some wilderness)
❌ ② 수자원 농업 → 식수 전용 불가 — 원문 일치
❌ ③ 다양한 목표 → 배분 결정 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ 무한히 공급 — 원문은 not enough. 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: not enough = 충분하지 않다. '무한히 공급'은 본문과 정반대

ch: 등산로와 야영지를 정비하면 자연 상태 보존과 상충할 수 있다.
수자원을 농업에 사용하면 도시 식수로 전용할 수 없다.
우리에게는 다양한 목표가 있어 자원 배분에 관한 결정이 필요하다.
이 나라의 숲은 목재와 여가를 모두 무한히 공급할 수 있다.

det.korean: renewing → renew: help + 목적어 + (to) 동사원형 구문에서 원형부정사가 필요하다. help a forest renewing은 비문.

④ allocate — how to allocate, to부정사 동사원형 정상
det.tip: help + 목적어 + (to) V원형: help a forest (to) renew itself

If we use fire to help a forest renew itself, we will have air pollution downwind while the fire burns. We have many goals, so we have to make choices about how to allocate our limited resources. The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost.

det.korean: 선택의 비용은 포기하는 것, 즉 잃어버린 기회(opportunities lost)의 비용이다.
det.analysis: 본문 단서: The cost of those choices is what we give up — the cost of opportunities lost → opportunities lost

air / burns / downwind / fire / have / pollution / the / we / while / will

→ __________

det.korean: 불이 타는 동안 바람 아래쪽에 대기 오염이 발생할 것이다.
det.analysis: we(주어) + will have(미래: ~을 갖게 될 것이다) + air pollution(대기 오염) + downwind(바람 아래쪽에) + while(접속사: ~하는 동안) + the fire(주어) + burns(동사) = 10단어. 주절(we will have air pollution downwind) + 종속절(while the fire burns).
det.tip: will have = ~을 갖게 될 것이다. downwind = 풍하(바람 아래쪽). while = ~하는 동안

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 본문은 숲, 물, 불 등의 예시를 통해 자원이 제한적이며 선택에는 기회비용이 따른다는 점을 설명한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 자연 자원 한정성과 기회비용 — 글 전체 핵심 주제 ←정답
❌ ② 캘리포니아 농업 발전 — 농업은 자원 배분 예시일 뿐
❌ ③ 산불 예방 방법 — 불은 자원 사용 예시이지 산불 예방이 아님
❌ ④ 숲 보존과 도시 개발 역사 — 역사적 변천 언급 없음
det.tip: limited resources + choices + cost = 기회비용(opportunity cost)

det.korean: 자원이 제한적이라 선택을 하면 무언가를 포기해야 하며, 이것이 기회비용이다.
det.analysis:

❌ ④ 기술로 해결 — 기술 언급 없음
det.tip: what we give up = 포기하는 것. 자원 배분의 트레이드오프

ch: 자원은 무한하므로 다양한 목표를 동시에 달성할 수 있다.

det.tip: cannot be used for ~ = ~에 사용될 수 없다 (수동태 부정)
